text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki ran through the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen. Voices among the 
fans rise up, hoping to see even greater 
feats from her...

Ever since then, however, she has been 
acting strange. It was as if her mind were 
somewhere else entirely...

Meanwhile, public attention soared to the 
point of becoming a social phenomenon. 
Awaiting next was the Yasuda Kinen, a mile 
race right in Fuji Kiseki's wheelhouse—
